query: WITH policy AS ( SELECT policy.kind, policy.max_attempts, policy.lease_offset_micros, policy.claim_limit FROM unnest($1::text[], $2::smallint[], $3::bigint[], $6::bigint[]) AS policy (kind, max_attempts, lease_offset_micros, claim_limit) ), candidates AS ( SELECT candidate.id, candidate.not_before, candidate.attempts, candidate.state, candidate.claim_expires_at, policy.max_attempts, policy.lease_offset_micros, policy.kind, policy.claim_limit FROM policy CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT job.id, job.not_before, job.attempts, job.state, job.claim_expires_at FROM background_jobs AS job WHERE job.state = 'pending' AND job.kind = policy.kind AND job.not_before <= statement_timestamp() ORDER BY job.not_before, job.id LIMIT policy.claim_limit FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) AS candidate UNION ALL SELECT candidate.id, candidate.not_before, candidate.attempts, candidate.state, candidate.claim_expires_at, policy.max_attempts, policy.lease_offset_micros, policy.kind, policy.claim_limit FROM policy CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT job.id, job.not_before, job.attempts, job.state, job.claim_expires_at FROM background_jobs AS job WHERE job.state = 'running' AND job.kind = policy.kind AND job.claim_expires_at <= statement_timestamp() ORDER BY job.not_before, job.id LIMIT policy.claim_limit FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) AS candidate ), ranked AS ( SELECT candidates.id, candidates.not_before, candidates.attempts, candidates.state, candidates.claim_expires_at, candidates.max_attempts, candidates.lease_offset_micros, candidates.claim_limit, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY candidates.kind ORDER BY candidates.not_before, candidates.id ) AS position FROM candidates ), picked AS ( SELECT ranked.id, ranked.attempts, ranked.lease_offset_micros, ranked.attempts >= ranked.max_attempts AS exhausted, ranked.state = 'running' AND ranked.claim_expires_at <= statement_timestamp() AS rescued FROM ranked WHERE ranked.position <= ranked.claim_limit ORDER BY ranked.not_before, ranked.id LIMIT $4 ) UPDATE background_jobs AS job SET state = CASE WHEN picked.exhausted THEN 'failed' ELSE 'running' END, failure_reason = CASE WHEN picked.exhausted THEN 'exhausted' END, finished_at = CASE WHEN picked.exhausted THEN statement_timestamp() END, claim_expires_at = CASE WHEN picked.exhausted THEN NULL ELSE statement_timestamp() + picked.lease_offset_micros * interval '1 microsecond' END, attempts = CASE WHEN picked.exhausted THEN picked.attempts ELSE picked.attempts + 1 END, attempted_by = CASE WHEN picked.exhausted THEN job.attempted_by ELSE $5 END, error_summary = CASE WHEN picked.rescued THEN $7::text WHEN picked.exhausted THEN COALESCE(job.error_summary, 'attempt budget spent') ELSE job.error_summary END, errors = CASE WHEN picked.rescued THEN job.errors || jsonb_build_object( 'attempt', picked.attempts, 'at', statement_timestamp(), 'error', $7::text) ELSE job.errors END, claim_generation = nextval('background_jobs_claim_generation') FROM picked WHERE job.id = picked.id AND ((job.state = 'pending' AND job.not_before <= statement_timestamp()) OR (job.state = 'running' AND job.claim_expires_at <= statement_timestamp())) RETURNING job.id, job.kind, (job.state = 'failed') AS "exhausted!", job.attempts, job.claim_generation, CASE WHEN job.state = 'running' THEN COALESCE(job.payload_text, job.payload::text) END AS payload, job.trace_context AS trace_parent, job.trace_state, job.error_summary, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp() - job.not_before)::double precision AS "queue_wait_seconds!"
